scope: Synthetic isolated local profile through production web gateway and native tools; no personal data or external effects.

steps.name: Pause, resume, cancel with saved permission

initial_findings: A completed schedule change needed an immediate list refresh to update the icon.
Generic create-wording imposed an unwanted Markdown artifact contract.
Long approval details hid permission choices and overflowed paths on mobile.
resolution: Added refresh after schedule changes, semantic routing for scheduling requests, and a bounded details area with persistent action choices. Repeated live lifecycle passed with zero artifacts.
limits: Synthetic development acceptance; no statistical reliability or local-model parity claim.
The isolated live test did not start its timer or execute a due scheduled prompt; existing scheduler/catch-up tests cover that boundary.
Scheduling permission does not grant execution tools, accounts or external actions.
Model-generated confirmation prose can still be verbose; concise human-facing timing is instructed.
